mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) exceeding 2% signals weakening household demand, which reduces earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative in periods where RSAFS YoY growth falls below -2% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 8% for three consecutive months signals persistent labor market slack, which reduces corporate profit margins and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE exceeds 8% for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 6-month decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) exceeding 3% signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces earnings growth and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO YoY growth falls below -3% for six months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 25 basis point or greater increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) triggers a tightening cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative after a 25 bps or larger FEDFUNDS increase (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous 3-month decline of at least 2% in both real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signals a broad-based demand contraction, which reduces earnings and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS and HOUST both fall > 2% over 3 months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both RSAFS and HOUST decline by more than 2% over three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise of at least 0.5 percentage points in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) and a decline of at least 1% in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) over three months signals a sharp labor market deterioration, which reduces earnings and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both UNRATE rises by 0.5pp and PAYEMS falls by 1% over three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 4-quarter cumulative decline of at least 5% in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals a deep and persistent demand contraction, which reduces earnings and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when RSAFS declines by at least 5% over four consecutive quarters (t-test p > 0.05).
